gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: Also worth ___ is the museum's medieval wing.
gaps.explanation: Also worth noting is… — fronted comment structure.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ a debut film attracted such wide attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely has a debut film attracted …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than problems arose.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive with inversion: had … been signed.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ she won the marathon, but she also broke the course record.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only has she won' — inversion with the present perfect auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the bridge unsafe, but it was also far too narrow.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the bridge unsafe' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.
gaps.explanation: Only after X did I realise… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: So convinced ___ he of his innocence that he refused the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'So convinced was he of …' — inversion after fronted 'so + adj'.
